assertions.description: The period expense report was written to report.json in the workspace
report.json reports the requested period as YYYY-MM
Exactly the claims passing all three inclusion rules (requested period, approved status, not Meals & Entertainment) were counted
grand_total is the sum of the counted claim-line amounts to be reimbursed

That claim_ids names exactly the exported claims of the requested period whose status is approved and whose category is not Meals & Entertainment (no extra id, no omitted id), and that every by_cost_center value is the sum of that cost center's counted line amounts and reconciles with grand_total, cannot be checked with the available assertion types: claim_ids and by_cost_center are data-derived lists/objects rather than fixed scalar values. Verify these by re-reading report.json against the downloaded CSV.
